office: the Immigration Department of Malaysia (Jabatan Imigresen Malaysia); abroad, Malaysia's representative offices
note: A ten-year passport is open from 18 only. Students under 21 on a bachelor's programme abroad and Haj pilgrims pay RM100 for five years.
